summary.text: Jamie Burger, a Republican from Benton, represents Missouri Senate District 27, which includes Bollinger, Cape Girardeau, Iron, Madison, Perry, Reynolds and Scott counties; he was elected in 2024.

He previously served District 148 in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2020 to 2024 and is vice-chair of several Senate committees, including Agriculture, Food Production and Outdoor Resources.

paragraphs.text: Burger was born in Sikeston and raised in New Hamburg, Missouri, and lives in Benton with his wife, Sherry.
They have three children and eight grandchildren.
Before entering the Legislature he spent 37 years, including 30 years in management, at Buzzi Unicem USA, Inc.
He also served 18 years on the Scott County Commission, 12 of them as presiding commissioner.
Burger is a member of St. Denis Catholic Church, where he serves as lector and Eucharistic minister, and belongs to the NRA, area chambers of commerce and the Knights of Columbus.
